async function have5RawIronIntoIronIngotsTask(bot) {
    // This function checks if the bot possesses at least five iron ingots. If not, it determines how many more are required. It verifies that enough raw iron is available to meet the target. If a furnace is not found nearby, it attempts to place one. It then searches for a suitable fuel source, such as coal or wood planks. Finally, it smelts the necessary raw iron into iron ingots using the found or placed furnace.
}
